## Projects

### manjaro-sway — Linux distribution
Manjaro Linux with Wayland, Sway and a lot of love. 798 stars, 29 forks.
- Live: https://manjaro-sway.download
- Source: https://github.com/manjaro-sway/manjaro-sway

### museumsufer — Frankfurt culture monorepo
Cloudflare Workers monorepo serving four public web apps that aggregate cultural programming across Frankfurt and Rhein-Main. All hourly/daily-scraped, static-bundled, no D1 hot-path.
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/museumsufer

#### museumsufer.app
Exhibitions and events from Frankfurt's 40+ museums on a fast, searchable page. 15+ deterministic scrapers (Tribe Events, schema.org, TYPO3 calendarize, WP REST + ACF, RSS, Kirby CMS), DeepL EN/FR translation, image-proxy, distance sorting via RMV, fuzzy search, PWA.
- Live: https://museumsufer.app/

#### frankfurt.ins.theater
Hourly performance schedule across 24 Frankfurt theaters — Schauspiel, Oper, Mousonturm, English Theatre, Komödie, Tigerpalast, the Reservix-fronted small houses, plus long-tail venues. Editorial Programmheft styling.
- Live: https://frankfurt.ins.theater

#### frankfurt.konzert.haus
Classical, jazz, sacred, world, experimental and chamber concerts across Frankfurt and the Rhein-Main region. No pop, no rock.
- Live: https://frankfurt.konzert.haus

#### landau.today
Events for Landau in der Pfalz and the Südliche Weinstraße from six public sources, aggregated into a single SSR page with URL-bound category and date filters.
- Live: https://landau.today

### werk-review
Modern, fast database and review platform for classical literature. Curated authors and works of world literature, automated Wikipedia/AI enrichment, Project Gutenberg-DE + LibriVox links.
- Live: https://werk.review
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/werk-review

### leave-work
Maximize your time off — vacation-day optimizer.
- Live: https://leave.work
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/leave-work

### dumm-rum
"Dumm rumstehen an Frankfurter Haltestellen seit 2026" — Frankfurt public-transport stop tool.
- Live: https://dummrum.de
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/dumm-rum

### noise
Browser-based audio noise reduction powered by DeepFilterNet3, running entirely client-side via WebAssembly.
- Live: https://noise.jonas-strassel.de/
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/noise

### pdf-unlock
Unlock password-protected PDFs in the browser using WebAssembly. No server upload.
- Live: https://pdf-unlock.jonas-strassel.de/
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/pdf-unlock

### dowwntime
Downtime checks, easy as pie.
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/dowwntime

### kernel-info
Webservice parsing kernel.org for kernel info.
- Live: https://kernel-info.manjaro-sway.download/
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/kernel-info

### aufteilung
The Karmarkar–Karp differencing algorithm in TypeScript.
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/aufteilung

### saferound
Sum-safe rounding for number arrays.
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/saferound
